fee_structure_confirmed_range.name: fee_structure_confirmed_range
fee_structure_confirmed_range.value: not "fee_structure"."data_confirmed" or ("fee_structure"."amount_min" is not null and "fee_structure"."amount_max" is not null and "fee_structure"."amount_min" > 0 and "fee_structure"."amount_max" >= "fee_structure"."amount_min")

lead_identity_or_anonymised.name: lead_identity_or_anonymised
lead_identity_or_anonymised.value:
("lead"."anonymised_at" is null and "lead"."name" is not null and btrim("lead"."name") <> '' and "lead"."whatsapp_e164" is not null and "lead"."whatsapp_e164" ~ '^[+][1-9][0-9]{6,14}$')
        or ("lead"."anonymised_at" is not null and "lead"."name" is null and "lead"."whatsapp_e164" is null and "lead"."email" is null and "lead"."results" = '[]'::jsonb)

placement_payment_void_consistency.name: placement_payment_void_consistency
placement_payment_void_consistency.value:
("placement_payment"."voided_at" is null and "placement_payment"."voided_by" is null and "placement_payment"."void_reason" is null)
        or ("placement_payment"."voided_at" is not null and "placement_payment"."voided_by" is not null and "placement_payment"."void_reason" is not null and btrim("placement_payment"."void_reason") <> '')
